package.name: kinect_audio_cpp
package.description:
C++ ROS 2 Jazzy driver for the Kinect v1 (Xbox 360) microphone array. Uses the libfreenect C audio API directly (libfreenect_audio.h) to access all four microphones and the hardware noise-cancelled beam-formed channel, bypassing ALSA entirely.
Published topics: /kinect/audio/raw (std_msgs/Int32MultiArray) 4-ch interleaved int32 /kinect/audio/cancelled (std_msgs/Int16MultiArray) HW noise-cancelled int16 /kinect/audio/info (std_msgs/String) JSON metadata
